canonical_trace_summary_contract.per_run_emission_scope: one validated summary per explicit emitter call

reference_boundary: OpenAI/Codex source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest promotes platform-neutral ADK trace and eval evidence contracts and must not enable hosted tracing, stored completions, external runtimes, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

evidence_policy.raw_fallback: link to local evidence path or platform trace id only when allowed

contracts.eval_use: Feed high-signal pass/fail examples into routing, governance, completion and macro-eval regression suites.

macro_eval_policy.promotion_rule: Promote only frequent and consequential failures with representative evidence into deterministic regression suites.
must_not: store raw traces with secrets
treat one-off cookbook examples as regression evidence
change an agent, tool or handoff before inspecting representative trace summaries
store raw user prompts containing secrets
enable production logging without data-retention approval
use stored outputs for long-term memory unless explicitly archived

regression_case_policy.promotion_rule: Promote a stored-session or trace summary only after it is redacted, linked to a dataset, has an explicit grader and fails before the candidate fix when feasible.
must_not: promote raw sessions or unredacted traces into fixtures
use a regression case without dataset_id, grader, score_threshold or regression_link
enable unattended stored-session monitoring without retention and owner approval

cross_field_invariants: available token_usage requires cached_input <= input; unavailable token_usage requires a reason
tool_calls equals the sum of tools_used call_count values
available outcome.status determines the allowed outcome.category; unavailable outcome requires a reason
succeeded outcomes contain no failed verification, failed guardrail, blocker or failure pattern
abstained is true if and only if outcome.status is abstained
abstained and wrong_skill cannot both be true
first_pass_success requires outcome.status=succeeded, human_interventions=0, wrong_skill=false and abstained=false

deprecated_compatibility_fields.goal: fixed to not-applicable; use goal_ref for an identifier only
deprecated_compatibility_fields.next_goal: fixed to null; use next_goal_ref for an identifier or null
deprecated_compatibility_fields.reason: The existing official trace governance gate requires the legacy field names on every trace contract.

cost_policy.available: non-negative amount and three-letter uppercase currency are required
cost_policy.unavailable: status=not-available and a non-empty reason are required
cost_policy.must_not: invent a zero amount when runtime pricing evidence is unavailable

token_usage_policy.available: non-negative input, cached_input and output are required
token_usage_policy.unavailable: status=not-available and a non-empty reason are required
token_usage_policy.must_not: invent zero token usage when runtime token evidence is unavailable

outcome_policy.available: a closed status/category pair is required
outcome_policy.unavailable: status=not-available and a non-empty reason are required
outcome_policy.must_not: infer success, failure, blocked, cancelled or abstained without caller-observed evidence

applies_to: workflow runtime adapters after explicit v2 opt-in
contracts.eval_use: Associate privacy-bounded caller-observed runtime facts with asset bundles without claiming automatic runtime or native target integration.
contracts.per_run_emission_scope: Each explicit emit_trace_summary_v2 call accepts one TraceRunFacts run_id and returns exactly one validated summary.
contracts.emitter_reason: A platform-neutral explicit-call emitter is available; runtime adapters must opt in separately.
contracts.runtime_integration_gate: A target may claim automatic per-run emission only after native conformance verifies the emitter call and summary retention boundary.

compatibility.migration_boundary: Consumers opt in to v2 only after their emitter and conformance tests are available.

must_not: claim automatic or native runtime trace emission from the explicit-call library API alone
store raw prompts, messages, tool arguments, tool results or tool payloads
infer unavailable cost, token, latency or runtime evidence
treat schema-valid local evidence as native runtime conformance

evidence_policy.raw_fallback: link to local evidence path or platform trace id only when allowed

contracts.eval_use: Promote only stable, short, complete and assertion-backed workflow demonstrations into replayable skills or automations.

replay_policy.promotion_rule: A recorded workflow is eligible only when inputs that vary between runs are named, success criteria are explicit, artifacts are hashable, and replay can be validated without secrets.
required_assertions: variable inputs are separated from fixed steps
generated artifacts have hashes or stable paths
manual replay notes identify non-deterministic steps
sensitive data is redacted or replaced with safe samples
must_not: store raw screen or desktop recordings as durable ADK evidence
promote workflows that depend on hidden personal preferences without documenting them
replay workflows that require credentials, payments, 2FA or private account state without explicit approval
treat a successful demonstration as approval to enable unattended automation

content_capture.reason: content fields can contain prompts, secrets, private source, tool payloads or high-cardinality data

interoperability_adapters.export_boundary: local sanitized summary only; no hosted exporter is enabled by this adapter
interoperability_adapters.unknown_field_policy: preserve in local ADK summary; do not invent an OpenTelemetry attribute
interoperability_adapters.rollback_path: disable adapter and retain the native ADK trace summary
must_not: enable prompt, completion, system instruction, tool argument or tool result capture by default
export traces to a provider as a side effect of schema conversion
invent a GenAI Schema URL or schema version while upstream leaves Schema URL unresolved
claim compatibility with an upstream revision other than the reviewed pinned revision
drop native ADK evidence fields that have no stable external mapping
